title: Optimizing Irreversible Perturbations of the Unadjusted Langevin Algorithm
summary: Irreversible perturbations accelerate the convergence of Langevin dynamics, breaking detailed balance while preserving the invariant measure. The design of optimal irreversible perturbations has been studied in the continuous-time Gaussian setting, but extensions to non-Gaussian target distributions, and the impact of time discretization on the design of optimal perturbations, have not been well understood.
